scripts.text:

So, I always put my hand up first!

I'd like this to be held at times that don't disturb my work.

scripts.speaker: Koon

scripts.speaker: Koon
scripts.text:

I am very interested in the language as well!

scripts.text:
Most of our cats are especially talented in language.
This has a great effect on the prosperity of our merchants.

scripts.speaker: Linguist Devore
scripts.text: Because... it means you can do business in more areas if you know more foreign languages.

scripts.speaker: Linguist Devore
scripts.text:
Hello everyone.
I am a linguist, Dr. Devore, in charge of the study on the Starfish language.

scripts.speaker: Linguist Devore
scripts.text: Let me say the definite conclusion first. Since ^0000FFthe study on the Starfish language^000000 started from the time we settled in Malangdo, there's been no remarkable outcome yet.

scripts.speaker: Linguist Devore
scripts.text: Of course it is possible to talk with ^6666ccBiscuit^000000 somehow, but this is not close to the result we expected to solve the situation.

scripts.speaker: Koon
scripts.text: Then, how's the study on the book we found last time?

scripts.speaker: Linguist Devore
scripts.text: This book we assumed to be written in the Starfish language. But when I asked Biscuit, it turns out that it's a textbook to learn the Starfish language...

scripts.speaker: Koon
scripts.text: Isn't it very helpful for studying the Starfish language, then?

scripts.speaker: Linguist Devore
scripts.text: I surely thought that, but when I tried the conversation as it teaches, we ended up finding they couldn't understand it at all.

scripts.speaker: Linguist Devore
scripts.text: If you see the words on the first page of this book, there's a sentence seeming like short conversation.

scripts.speaker: President of Meeting
scripts.text:
Ok, we listened well to what Dr. Devore said.
Then, let's wrap up the progress of the language study, and listen to Geologist, Dr. Mali.

scripts.speaker: Linguist Devore
scripts.text:
Hoo...
The Starfish language is the hardest matter in my studying life.

scripts.speaker: Linguist Devore
scripts.text:
I should solve the puzzling Starfish language soon.
I'm ashamed to see you all like this as a result.

scripts.speaker: Linguist Devore
scripts.text:
Right...
This language world is so beautiful and mysterious.

scripts.speaker: Linguist Devore
scripts.text: There are mysteries like why the same beings use totally different languages, or why very far kinds use similar languages.

scripts.speaker: Linguist Devore
scripts.text: I joined this group because I thought that traveling all around the world was much more helpful to study, not just reading a book at a desk.

scripts.speaker: Linguist Devore
scripts.text:
But this Starfish is just mysterious.
I cannot understand it at all.
I am rather doubtful to say it's actual 'language'.

scripts.speaker: Linguist Devore
scripts.text:
I have no clue, though I study it in various ways.
Biscuit got used to our language, rather, and short talk is possible, but we cannot say it is conversation yet.

scripts.speaker: Linguist Devore
scripts.text: I feel frustrated and more to study like this, but it should be solved to deal with the other matters.

scripts.speaker: Linguist Devore
scripts.text:
I don't see what's wrong here!
Myself, who used to be called a master of language!
I've never expected to come across this untouchable stuff!

scripts.speaker: Linguist Devore
scripts.text:
Wooaaa wooaaa ahhh!!!!

scripts.speaker: Linguist Devore
scripts.text:

scripts.speaker: Linguist Devore

scripts.text:

it has magic so that you end up continously doing it over and over.
